description:
Stated by the fz-kdt.96 builder (2026-08-31, c6edce73a) and deliberately
not closed there.

fz-kdt.96 made the ANSWER per-member: each group member projects the
shared evidence through its own layout, analyzed type and demand, so
which member's job closes the cycle cannot change what any member says.
What it did NOT make structural is the EVIDENCE itself. At
jobs/transport.rs the knot still asks `pending_dependency_reaches` and
`pending_recursive_group` (pull.rs `pending_strong_component`), and
`recursive_group_callable_owners` gathers evidence from the external
dependencies of exactly those members. Group membership is mutual
reachability in the PENDING dependency graph -- transient state -- so a
different schedule could in principle admit a different member set and
therefore a different evidence union.

NOT OBSERVED: across all 61 knot-exercising fixtures the canonical dump
is byte-identical to base after fz-kdt.96, and byte-identical under the
`pending.reverse()` perturbation; under a full-LIFO agenda the residual
movement is byte-for-byte what base already had (fz-kdt.101). Every knot
measured holds members that all share one structural shape, and their
projections differ only in boundary publications. So this is a
correct-by-construction gap, not a measured defect.

WHY IT IS NOT CLOSED HERE: fz-kdt.93's refuted graveyard applies
directly -- boxed-Exact at the pending cut deadlocks, per-member knot
re-evaluation livelocks, because pending queries are transient state the
evaluation's own reads mutate. The sound direction is fz-kdt.93's: decide
the cut from a FACT at recipe construction and make the construction
graph acyclic, which would delete the last transport users of
`pending_dependency_reaches`/`pending_recursive_group` and with them
pull.rs's whole product-group machinery
(`pending_strong_component`, `recursive_group_callable_owners`,
`callable_group_layout`, `finish_callable_construction_group`).

FIRST STEP IF PICKED UP: establish whether callable-construction
evaluation IS a DAG under a structural rule. Its cycles are value-flow,
not call-graph: the measured knots are 4-member groups of the form
{input#2 of A, v_k of A, input#2 of B, v_j of B} for a mutually recursive
pair (reduce_cont/reduce_step, reduce_while_cont/reduce_while_step), so
the same CallGraphComponent + non-rising-function-id test fz-kdt.93 used
is the candidate to measure first. Sequenced with fz-kdt.98 and
fz-kdt.100 (all callable-side transport residuals).
title: The callable-construction knot's EVIDENCE set is still drawn from transient scheduler state
